replay_steps: Use the existing fictional custom map and preserve its ground-floor layer and room.
Create one separate image-backed Data Layer named TRAINING ONLY - GIS import, Order10. Use the supplied schematic image. Verify the new saved row and resolve its fresh ID through the UI.
Open Import for the intended map. Explicitly select the GIS layer and the supplied GeoJSON file, then Import once.
Inspect Complete history, then open Region Editor for the target layer and inspect both names and polygons.
Select each polygon to review properties. For Training room - import: TypeRoom, Color#d47a00, Searchablefalse, Dispatchablefalse. Save and reopen.
For Equipment - import: TypeRoom, Color#3388ff, Searchablefalse, Dispatchablefalse. Save and reopen.
Verify both names, geometry and absence of Dispatchable badges; reopen Import History. The new form resets to the first layer, so select the intended target before each subsequent import.
Do not import again merely to refresh a capture; fresh recordings need their own scenario and duplicate review. Source017is an unsaved form replay cancelled without a duplicate layer.
limits: GeoJSON polygon import only; no KML/KMZ, line/point, deduplication, live dispatch, automatic sync or failed-import recovery verified.
The diagram and polygons are fictional and do not describe the real background buildings.
Fresh IDs and timestamps differ on replay.
